title: UCSC hgFixed Gene Interactions and pathway evidence tables
provenance: Integrated product constructed for the UCSC Gene Interactions graph from 23 curated pathway/protein-interaction databases and text-mined PubMed abstracts. UCSC source README says ggTables loads gg-prefixed tables into hgFixed. The help describes the abstract corpus as 20 million abstracts processed at end-2014. These are evidence sources combined into one UCSC graph product, not a single experimental study.

biological_context.assay: heterogeneous curated pathway/protein interaction evidence plus natural-language text mining
biological_context.metadata: gene-pair links, support source/types, PubMed document links, event-level evidence

assets.version: UCSC database table snapshot reported by page
assets.format: MariaDB hgFixed tables: ggLink, ggLinkEvent, ggEventDb, ggEventText, ggDocEvent, ggDoc, ggGeneClass, ggGeneName
assets.processing_stage: integrated graph database used by Gene Interactions viewer
assets.source_reported_details: Public ggLink schema reported 1,322,485 rows; data last updated 2017-06-04.

assets.version: curated source vintages vary; text mining run at end of 2014
assets.source_reported_details: Guide names 23 curated databases; examples include Reactome 2014 and WikiPathways 20170510, and states text mining analyzed 20 million PubMed abstracts.

access_and_terms: Interactive schema and tables are described as accessible through the Table Browser, public MariaDB server and downloads server. Public reachability does not establish reuse rights for each constituent; source help notes one cited OpenBEL large corpus version carried a non-commercial license, and KEGG version predates a license change.
inspection: Read pinned hgGeneGraph README, viewer source and methods/data-access help plus public hgFixed ggLink schema. No table dump or row values were downloaded.
limitations: The product is historical and source versions differ; exact current table availability is unverified. This combined annotation product is not a homogeneous assay or experimentally observed cohort. Source-specific licenses and reuse restrictions need independent review.
